routes.name: New Route
routes.desc: New short and easy line just left of 'Shadow Show'.

routes.name: Shadow Show
routes.desc: Just before the boulders towards 'One-Two-Three', up the white streak. 3 titanium bolts, 1 sling Share start with Idapaccayada.

routes.name: Idapaccayada
routes.desc: Climbs 'Shadow Show', then veers right and finishes on the anchor of 'Shooting Through'. 4 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Shooting Through
routes.desc: Up the black streak right of 'Shadow Show'. Shares the anchor with 'Idapaccayada'. 3 titanium bolts, 3 slings.

routes.name: Nam Dtah See Som / Orange Tears
routes.desc: Reachy move over the bulge at the start. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Bad Boy
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Nuat Hin' and Pattica Samupade. Then straight up after the 3rd clip. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: Nuat Hin / Massage the Rock
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Bad Boy' and Pattica Samupade. Then climbs up right into the cave. 6 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Pattica Samupade
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Nuat Hin' and Bad Boy. Then traverses right at the overhang and up the pillar. 4 titanium bolts, 3 slings.

routes.name: Piece of Cake
routes.desc: Extension of 'Pattica Samupade'. Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.

routes.name: Muay Thai
routes.desc: Crux at the first overhang. Be careful, a lead fall can be dangerous with the ledge below. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Chicken Head
routes.desc: Starts just to right of 'Muay Thai'. Shares the start and anchors with 'Reaching Like a Monkey'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Reaching Like a Monkey
routes.desc: Shares the start and anchor with 'Chicken Head', then veers right. Not rebolted with titanium. All stainless steel glue-in bolts.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Not rebolted with titanium. All stainless steel glue-in bolts.

routes.name: No Name
routes.desc: Old route left of 'Deborah'. Shares anchors with 'Chicken Head' and 'Reaching Like a Monkey'. Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.

routes.name: Deborah
routes.desc: Old rusty expansion bolts. Do not climb!
warnings: Fixed Gear: Old rusty expansion bolts.

routes.name: Tamada
routes.desc: All slings. Be prepared to replace.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: Hello Christine
routes.desc: All slings. Be prepared to replace.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: Valentine
routes.desc: Short climb with a cool little cave you can peek into. Solid rock, less polished than the routes over at 'One-Two-Three' wall. 3 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

routes.name: Alone
routes.desc: 2 titanium bolts, 4 slings

routes.name: Take It to the Left
routes.desc: All slings. Be prepared to replace.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: Vegan Snake
routes.desc: Can only be climbed on top rope from the anchors of 'Take It Easy'.

routes.name: Take It Easy
routes.desc: All slings. Be prepared to replace.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: The Beacons Memorial Climb
routes.desc: All slings. Be prepared to replace.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: The Devine Ascention of Sully
routes.desc: All slings. Be prepared to replace.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace.

routes.name: Unknown Route
routes.desc: Route furthest to the right, longer than the other easy climbs beside it. All slings. Be prepared to replace.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Be prepared to replace.
